nom: bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum reduces shine and oil production and leaves a matte finish without feeling greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly describe the serum as hydrating, soothing, and non-irritating, though one reports it burned on application.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it balances their skin, leaving oily areas matte while keeping the rest smooth and comfortable, without pilling.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or breakouts despite the added fragrance, though a couple describe the scent as overwhelming or note some jaw and T-zone irritation with daily use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention being older or in perimenopause mostly report softer fine lines and a more radiant look after a few weeks, though one older reviewer with dry skin reports it burned her skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who used the serum for three weeks or longer commonly report visibly softened fine lines, wrinkles, and improved texture and elasticity; several who had only used it for about two weeks say they had not yet noticed any change.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report increased hydration and fewer dry patches; dissent includes one reviewer who found the reformulated version left her skin dry and dull compared to the original, and another who says her skin still lacks moisture despite the lightweight texture.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report visibly calmer, less red skin on the cheeks, nose, and overall complexion; one reviewer says the tightness and dryness in her cheeks eased but the redness there remained, and another says she saw no reduction in redness at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say the serum leaves skin feeling stronger, calmer, and more resilient, including one whose barrier was irritated and inflamed before use; however, one reviewer's skin burned on repeated application, and another says her skin did not feel significantly stronger despite the 'barrier boosting' claim.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports a noticeable reduction in dark spots alongside improved texture after several weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer reports the serum causing new breakouts; several with sensitive or reactive skin specifically confirm it did not break them out despite the added fragrance, and one reports fewer breakouts than usual.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the serum reduces shine and oil production, leaving a matte, non-greasy finish without pilling.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup, no pilling

extraits.titre: This new formulation is drying out my skin!
extraits.texte: I had used two bottles of the original Skinlongevity Longlife Herb Serum and I was very happy with the results. I ordered my 3rd bottle and noticed the formulation had changed and I was skeptical but remained hopeful that it will be good as the first. Wrong! This new one makes my skin look dry and dull looking. The original product made my skin look radiant and bright and moisturized; it also had a fresh almost lemony scent but subtle. What a difference! I would like to return this product. Clearly, it's doing me more harm than good.

I was excited to add the SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide to my routine. My skin issues vary depending on the weather and even allergens conditions. Currently my biggest issue is dryness around my forehead, cheeks, and even my brows. My skin feels tight and looks so dry even after applying face moisturizer. Unfortunately the wind and air in my area makes these issue worst during summer and often have to switch current products that helps but do make more issues. I admit that I was doubtful two pumps of the SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum would be sufficient for face and neck but it covers so well and while I do avoid my eyes, I make sure to cover my brows. The scent is so very light and doesn't linger once it absorbs which happens very quickly. The consistency of the product is light and liquidity which makes it easier to apply. I had no issues with side effects. And truthfully, I felt instant comfort after first application. The tightness that I felt due the dryness was gone and I didn't feel it after it absorbed into my skin which has happened with similar products. For this, the Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum is superior to any of the products I have used before. Unfortunately I didn't see any improvements in improving fine lines. While mine and not deep or that visible yet, I didn't see any change. I feel the redness in my cheeks remains. All these after using the product for about 2 weeks straight. Overall, I say the pro

Having dry skin and getting a little bit older, I am always happy to try something new that may be beneficial on numerous fronts. When I had the opportunity to try this new serum, I was anxious to do so. I proceeded with my regular skin care routine, and replaced my normal serum with this product. Surprisingly, my skin burned! Thinking my skin may have been acting different that day or something was just off, the following night I gave it another try with the same results. Wanting to give the product a fair chance, I even changed up to some of the other products that I use and added this to that routine with unfortunately, the same burning results. I wish I could say that this was a positive review, but unfortunately, it was not.

Love everything about this product! Pleasant smell, super lightweight, and gentle on the skin. I used this product over the course of multiple weeks and noticed a huge difference in my dark spots and texture.i tend to try out skincare products often which sometimes can take a toll on my skin. Prior to receiving this product, my skin barrier was quite irritated and inflamed. I took before and after photos which really highlight the differences in my skin

extraits.titre: Dramatic results with ingredients I can pronounce!
extraits.texte: After using this serum for several weeks, my skin feels noticeably firmer and more lifted. It was gentle and kind to my very sensitive, redness-prone skin. The fine lines on my forehead and my neck appear softer, and my overall complexion looks more radiant and refreshed. I am thrilled to find such dramatic results from a "clean beauty" line.

I have dry, aging skin that's easily irritated, and this serum has been such a treat. It sinks in beautifully, calms redness, and leaves my face feeling soft and plump. After just a couple weeks, my texture is smoother and my skin feels truly nourished,not just coated. It's a staple in my routine now!

extraits.titre: A must for combo to oily skin
extraits.texte: This Skinlongevity Barrier Boosting Serum is just what my combination, leaning oily skin needed! My skin drank this serum up. It left my skin smooth, supple, yes matte, brighter and not tight or dry. It did not pill ever. Your skin will thank you.
